entities.summary: James French Hill is an American businessman and politician serving as the U.S. representative for Arkansas's 2nd congressional district since 2015. He is a member of the Republican Party. French Hill was a performers & entertainers from Little Rock (b. 1956-12-05, Little Rock). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
